description: Get recent posts for elon/cruz (X tweets) or trump (Truth Social), up to 100 per page with the is_counted flag. Needs a Polystrike Data key (X-API-Key header on the MCP request).

limit.description: Number of tweets to return (1-100, default 50)

user.description: Tracked account. Default elon. Trump is Truth Social posts, not X tweets.

name: get_recent_tweets
